training: All original paired-valid validation rows; harmful=-1, unchanged=0, helpful=1 based on the same frozen pipeline policies. Nonreferrals are unchanged. No target labels in features.
score: P(helpful)-P(harmful); monotonic (utility+1)/2 mapping for prior cutoff code.
classifiers: One-vs-rest logistic with normalized class probabilities and weighted multiclass kNN. Original design weights with equal dataset mass. No class rebalancing.
comparison: Hold prior validation-selected architectures fixed separately for each backbone/judge/policy/family, retune original C or k grid and per-dataset gate cutoff using grouped validation folds. This isolates training-outcome treatment; not a new architecture sweep. Compare against preserved disagreement-only outputs.
data: Same cached target/neighbour activations, PCA fits, splits, target-grouped folds, case masks, population denominators, and weights as parent. No new inference. Freeze all selections before testing.
caveats: Test set previously examined; exploratory. Prior architectures were selected for disagreement-only training, not specifically optimized for the three-class task.
